maioio-genesis-architect-fix-issue.description: Fix a GitHub issue end to end -- read it, reproduce, patch, add a regression test, verify, and open a PR. Use when given an issue number or URL in this repo.

maioio-genesis-architect-root.description: Use when starting a new project. Genesis finds real production failures from similar GitHub repos, then builds a working MVP immediately - not just documents. Two modes: fast-mvp (5 min research cap, builds right after) and deep-research (full analysis). Success = user can run the project. Triggers on: "genesis init [vision]", "I want to build X", "scaffold", "new project", "set up project", "start building", "create a tool", "make a CLI", "bootstrap", "בנה פרויקט", "צור פרויקט", "התחל פרויקט".

maioio-genesis-architect-repo-polish.description: Run the repo's lint, format-check and test suite, then fix anything that fails. Use before opening a PR or when asked to "polish" or "clean up" the repo.
